answer: Identity cost is amortised over behaviour rather than purchase. A key is free to create and worth nothing until it answers a fresh shale. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest lagoon a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. An attacker's arithmetic: N identities cost N independent generations per epoch forever, plus N chances of a failed grade, and the ripple is shared, not multiplied. Seal 1fl6i.
